name: Toujou Keiko
source:
The group leader of a marketing department belonging to a public company. She is an accomplished office lady who was given the role of section manager at a very young age.

In her private life, she shares a room with fellow office worker [url=/c28420]Fujimori Shou[/url], and although she has feelings for him, she fell into despair upon realizing that her love for him is unrequited.

She joined the group to reaffirm her identity as a woman.
